title: Knit a 98K
description: Merge yarn, craft outrageous handmade weapons from slingshots to sniper 98Ks, and put your quirky creations to the test on the firing range.
controls: Tap to weave weapon parts, assemble upgrades, and aim on the range to blast mission targets.

zh-CN.title: 织个 98K
zh-CN.description: 脑洞爆笑创意爆款织个 98K：一针一线亲手织出从弹弓到 98K 狙击枪的奇葩神兵，上靶场实弹开火笑料百出！
zh-CN.controls: 点击编织并组装升级各类脑洞武器，前往靶场瞄准射击完成趣味挑战。
